title: Craft vanishing into mountains in the Uinta Basin

tellings.quote: crafts vanishing into mountains is [music] a documented phenomenon, especially in places like the Uinta Basin.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that unknown craft vanishing into mountains is a documented phenomenon, especially in places like the Uinta Basin, a remote region of northeastern Utah. He gives no date or specific case, but if true it would suggest these objects have hidden places inside the earth.
